read: Mal OSHB and UXLC canonical source views

versification_crosswalk.guard: Coordinates are not boundary, canon, chronology, or witness authority.

evidence_only_guard: Hebrew phrase/clause context, morphology labels, disputation formulae, particles, audience shifts, wordplay, accents, Masoretic section marks, English formatting, translation difficulty, and witness pressure are evidence only. Strong-style numbers, roots, lemmas, and etymologies are not lexical or boundary authority. This proposal decides no theology, doctrine, identity, history, chronology, fulfillment, canon, authorship, speaker, referent, witness, reading, translation, ethics, or source tradition.

massa.use: Superscription evidence; genre and name/title remain unresolved.

amar_family.use: Book-level disputation cohesion, not one-question-per-unit authority.

ki.use: Clause-context evidence for grounds and continuations, never an automatic split.

az.use: Response shift inside the final speech/day parent.

messenger.use: Lexical pressure only; no identity or fulfillment.

masoretic_section_marker_audit.use: Internal-seam evidence that does not automatically defeat stronger disputation or day-chain cohesion.
masoretic_section_marker_audit.hold: OSHB and UXLC are correlated Leningrad-family views, not independent textual votes.

macro_parent_alternatives: Mal.1.2-Mal.4.6 full disputation/oracle body after the massa

textual_translation_hard_zones.pressure: Massa, beyad, malakhi, and the lexical recurrence at 3:1.
textual_translation_hard_zones.hold: No authorship, name/title, messenger identity, canon, or genre-theology decision.

textual_translation_hard_zones.pressure: Name/honor, table/food/offering, nations, curse/blessing, seed/dung, Levi covenant, torah, and messenger vocabulary.
textual_translation_hard_zones.hold: No cult, priestly-office, covenant, history, or preferred-translation ruling.

textual_translation_hard_zones.pressure: One father/God, bagad, daughter of a foreign god, er ve-oneh, tears, witness, and covenant-wife expressions.
textual_translation_hard_zones.hold: No identity, marital-policy, ethnic, legal, historical, or doctrinal ruling.

textual_translation_hard_zones.pressure: Ve-lo ehad asah, u-shear ruah lo, u-mah ha-ehad, zera elohim, singular/plural spirit guarding, ki-sane shalah, and ve-kissah hamas al-levusho create clause, subject, object, vocalization, versional, and translation pressure.
textual_translation_hard_zones.hold: Keep together and preserve exact splits; no preferred construal, version, ethic, or doctrine.

textual_translation_hard_zones.pressure: Justice question, hinni sholeah malakhi, ha-adon, malakh habberit, shifting persons, coming, refining, and judgment.
textual_translation_hard_zones.hold: Keep question-answer parent; no identity, speaker, referent, chronology, fulfillment, temple event, or theology.

textual_translation_hard_zones.pressure: Shuvu/ve-ashuvah/bammah nashuv, rare q-b-a, tithe/offering, command/test, conditional syntax, and ad-beli-day.
textual_translation_hard_zones.hold: No root authority, finance doctrine, promise mechanism, preferred gloss, or ethic.

textual_translation_hard_zones.pressure: Az, memory book, segullah, ve-shavtem, ki-hinneh hayom, root/branch, sun/wings/healing, and ashes across English chaptering.
textual_translation_hard_zones.hold: No judgment system, violence endorsement, identity, chronology, fulfillment, symbolism, or theology.

textual_translation_hard_zones.pressure: MT 3:22-24 mapping; remember, Moses/Torah/Horeb, behold/sending, Elijah, day, ve-heshiv, al, and herem.
textual_translation_hard_zones.hold: No canon order, law system, identity, fulfillment, family model, curse reading, chronology, or witness choice.

dss_where_extant.guard: No extant-coverage, absence, reconstruction, date, relationship, or reading asserted.

targum.guard: No expansion, identity, chronology, interpretation, or reading asserted.

global_holds.witnesses: No witness or source tradition is selected. Ancient-version and DSS evidence remains external-review work.
global_holds.source_rendering: UXLC embeds an x element with a Latin t inside displayed Mal.2.17 wa-amartem; this is rendering metadata, not a Hebrew witness reading or boundary.
global_holds.versification: English Mal.4.1-6 maps to MT Mal.3.19-24.
global_holds.speech_identity: All prophetic, divine, disputant, priest, people, messenger, Lord, Moses, and Elijah identities or referents remain unresolved.
global_holds.confidence_policy: Every unit and disputed seam is LOW and deferred_human_or_external_ai.

appeals.disagreement_with: Splitting 1:6-2:9 without preserving its priestly parent.
appeals.rationale: The priest audience, name, offerings, command, Levi covenant, torah, and messenger sequence cohere across the chapter.

appeals.disagreement_with: Forcing either the 2:12 section split or the 2:10-16 parent.
appeals.rationale: Pe and ve-zot shenit support an internal seam; bagad and covenant language support the parent.

appeals.disagreement_with: Any preferred reading or ethical/doctrinal ruling at 2:15-16.
appeals.rationale: Clause division, subjects, ruah, ehad, shalah, hamas, and person shifts require versional/expert review.
appeals.uncertainty: LOW; ancient versions not locally examined.

appeals.rationale: The justice question is answered by sending, coming, refining, and judgment.

appeals.disagreement_with: Resolving messenger, Lord, covenant-messenger, speaker, or fulfillment identity at 3:1.
appeals.rationale: Discourse cohesion does not authorize identity.
appeals.uncertainty: LOW; versional and canonical review required.

appeals.rationale: Shuv/bammah opens, q-b-a/bammah specifies, and commands/consequences complete one dispute.
appeals.uncertainty: LOW; lexical, syntax, and witness review required.

appeals.disagreement_with: An English chapter split between 3:18 and 4:1.
appeals.rationale: Az, day, return/discern, ki-hinneh, fear-the-name, and MT pe after 4:3 support the parent.

appeals.disagreement_with: Forced attachment of 4:4-6 or an identity/canon ruling from placement.
appeals.rationale: Remember and behold open a coda after the MT pe, while day and shuv link backward.

proposed_units.deciding_marker: Massa devar YHWH el-Yisrael beyad malakhi is a nominal heading before the love dispute.
proposed_units.rejected_alternative: Absorb into 1:2-5 or let malakhi/3:1 decide authorship or identity.
proposed_units.risk: Genre, agency, name/title, authorship, messenger wordplay.
proposed_units.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: No finite disputation exchange occurs until ahavti/amar/wa-amartem at 1:2.

proposed_units.literary_form: Love disputation with Edom counter-speech and seeing close
proposed_units.deciding_marker: Ahavti/amar/wa-amartem opens; Jacob-Esau, ki-tomar Edom, and second-person eyes/you-will-say complete the exchange.
proposed_units.rejected_alternative: Split 1:2-3 from 1:4-5 or merge with the priest address.
proposed_units.risk: Love/hate, Edom, destruction, return, borders, chronology, theology.
proposed_units.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Amar/wa-amartem and closing second-person seeing/saying frame the unit before priests at 1:6.

proposed_units.literary_form: Priestly name-honor, offering, command, and Levi-covenant disputation
proposed_units.deciding_marker: Priests are named at 1:6 and 2:1; wa-amartem, name/offering, command, Levi, torah, messenger, and but-you contrast close at the pe after 2:9.
proposed_units.rejected_alternative: Treat 1:6-14 and 2:1-9 as unrelated or split mechanically after 1:13.
proposed_units.risk: Offerings, nations, curse, seed/dung, Levi covenant, torah, messenger, office, history.
proposed_units.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Name, honor/fear, offerings, command, covenant, torah, path, and messenger sustain the parent while section seams remain explicit.

proposed_units.literary_form: Communal treachery, covenant, altar-tears, and marriage disputation
proposed_units.deciding_marker: One-father/God questions broaden the audience; bagad recurs; ve-zot shenit and wa-amartem al-mah open the second movement; spirit guarding and lo tivgodu close at samekh.
proposed_units.rejected_alternative: Force either a seamless paragraph or final split after the pe at 2:12.
proposed_units.risk: Covenant, foreign-god phrase, marriage, 2:15-16 syntax/witnesses, ethics, doctrine.
proposed_units.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Five bagad tokens, covenant/altar/offering, the rejoinder, and paired spirit-guarding support the parent; 2:15-16 remains maximally held.

proposed_units.literary_form: Justice disputation answered by messenger, refining, offering, and judgment
proposed_units.deciding_marker: Hogatem/wa-amartem opens the justice question; hinni/hinneh answers; who-can-endure and ki explain; ve-qaravti la-mishpat closes.
proposed_units.rejected_alternative: Split at chapter or isolate 3:1 as an identity proof-text.
proposed_units.risk: Messenger/Lord identities, speaker, temple, coming, refining, chronology, fulfillment, judgment.
proposed_units.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: The 2:17 question requires 3:1-5; sending, coming, day, refining, offering, and first-person judgment cohere without resolving identities.

proposed_units.literary_form: Return, robbery, tithe, test, and land-result disputation
proposed_units.deciding_marker: Ki ani and sons-of-Jacob frame; shuvu/ve-ashuvah receives bammah nashuv; q-b-a receives another bammah; bring/test and results close at samekh.
proposed_units.rejected_alternative: Split return from robbery or command from consequences.
proposed_units.risk: Shuv, q-b-a, tithes, curse, test, conditional, ad-beli-day, finance doctrine, proof-texting.
proposed_units.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Triple shuv and repeated bammah bind the dispute; commands, results, and nations/land complete it.

proposed_units.literary_form: Harsh-speech dispute, fearers, remembered distinction, and coming-day outcome
proposed_units.deciding_marker: Wa-amartem opens; az turns to fearers; layom and ve-shavtem anticipate ki-hinneh hayom; fear-my-name and repeated bayom close at MT pe after English 4:3.
proposed_units.rejected_alternative: Split mechanically at English chapter or detach 4:1-3 from 3:17-18.
internal_seams: Mal.3.18/Mal.4.1 samekh plus continuing day explanation
proposed_units.risk: Service, fearers, memory, segullah, day, fire, sun/healing, ashes, violence, chronology, theology.
proposed_units.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Az, fear/name, remembrance, layom, ve-shavtem, ki-hinneh hayom, and day recurrence sustain MT 3:13-21.

proposed_units.deciding_marker: Zikru opens Moses/Torah; hinneh anokhi sholeah opens Elijah/day; ve-heshiv and pen-avo close.
proposed_units.rejected_alternative: Fold silently into 3:13-4:3, split without parent, or use placement to decide canon/identity.
proposed_units.risk: Versification, Torah/Moses/Horeb, Elijah, day, shuv, family, herem, fulfillment, canon.
proposed_units.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: MT pe after English 4:3 supports a coda; paired zikru/hinneh plus ve-heshiv and pen-avo bind MT 3:22-24.
